licence.title: Physician Associate (PA) licence (Oregon renamed physician assistants to physician associates)
licence.renewalDeadline: December 31 of each odd numbered year (next: Dec 31, 2027); Emeritus status renews every Dec 31; licence lapses if not renewed

ce.cyclePeriod: two year registration period (30 hours if licensed in the second year of the biennium); OMB states it as 30 hours per year
ce.categoryRules: AMA Category 1, AOA 1-A or 2-A, or AAPA Category 1 (pre-approved), relevant to current practice; Emeritus: 15 hours per year (AAPA Category 1 or 2)

topicMandates.topic: Pain management (Oregon Pain Management Commission one hour course)
topicMandates.appliesTo: all OMB licensees except lapsed, teleradiology and telemonitoring licences; at initial licensure and every 24 months
all practicing OMB licensees except residents and Volunteer Camp licensees; average 1 hour per year over the audit period (current period 2024 to 2027, audited at the Fall 2027 renewal)

ce.controlledSubstanceCe: None beyond the pain management course

practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: Written collaboration agreement signed by a physician or employer; kept at the PA's primary practice location and produced to the OMB on request (not filed with the board); reviewed and updated as part of the performance assessment; amended in writing for any change. PAs with fewer than 2,000 postgraduate clinical hours need a Specified Collaboration Plan in the agreement.
practice.notes: Collaborative practice model replaced supervision for all Oregon PAs by Jan 1, 2024 (HB 3036, 2021; HB 2584, 2023). Non compliance carries a $195 fine.

prescribing.separateAuthorityRegistration: No separate prescriptive registration; PAs may prescribe Schedules II to V. Schedule II requires current NCCPA certification. Dispensing needs separate OMB registration.
prescribing.ceForPrescribers: None found beyond the all-licensee pain management course

facts.value: Dec 31 of odd numbered years
facts.quote: must be satisfactorily complete on or before December 31 of each odd-numbered year.
Physician Associate (PA) TWO-YEAR REGISTRATION PERIOD Renewal Fees

facts.value: licence lapses Dec 31 if not renewed
facts.quote: A license not renewed by December 31 will lapse, and the licensee may not practice.
facts.note: The same page shows "2026 One-Year License Renewals" (licences expiring Dec 31, 2026) for one year registrants; the standard PA biennium still ends Dec 31 of odd years per OAR 847-008-0005(1).

facts.value: 60 hours per 2 years or NCCPA recertification
facts.quote: 60 hours of continuing medical education (CME) per two years relevant to the licensee's current medical practice
Ongoing participation in a program of recertification or maintenance of certification by ... the National Commission on Certification of Physician Assistants (NCCPA)

facts.value: AAPA Category 1 (pre-approved) or AMA/AOA Category 1
facts.quote: American Academy of Physician Associates (AAPA) Category 1 (pre-approved)

facts.value: 30 hours/year (Active, Locum Tenens, Telemedicine Active)
facts.quote: Physician Associate Status: Active, Locum Tenens, or Telemedicine Active 30 hours/year

facts.value: 1 hour every 24 months
facts.quote: must complete one-hour of continuing education in pain management at initial licensure and every 24 months
facts.note: ORS 677.510(5) (loaded) says documentation every 36 months; OAR 847-008-0075(1) and the OMB CE page say every 24 months; the stricter rule is used.

facts.value: minimum 1 hour per year (2 hours per 2 year registration period); reported and audited every other renewal (4 hours over a typical 4 year audit period)
facts.quote: Complete a minimum of one continuing education hour per year

facts.value: current audit period 2024 to 2027
facts.quote: The current audit period for most licensees is 2024-2027 and will be audited during the Fall 2027 renewal.

facts.value: collaboration agreement required to practise
facts.quote: A physician associate may not practice medicine unless the physician associate has entered into a collaboration agreement

facts.value: kept at primary practice location; to OMB on request
facts.quote: The collaboration agreement must be kept on file at the physician associates primary location of practice and made available to the Oregon Medical Board

facts.value: plan required under 2,000 postgraduate hours
facts.quote: If the physician associate has fewer than 2,000 hours of post-graduate clinical experience, a plan for consistent and quality collaboration

facts.value: reviewed as part of performance assessment
facts.quote: As part of the performance assessment in ORS 677.510(4), a collaboration agreement must be reviewed and, if applicable, updated.

facts.value: Schedules II to V
facts.quote: A physician associate is authorized to write prescriptions, including prescriptions for controlled substances listed in Schedules II through V.

facts.value: Schedule II requires current NCCPA certification
facts.quote: if the physician associate is currently certified by the National Commission for the Certification of Physician Assistants (NCCPA).

facts.value: all PAs on collaborative practice by Jan 1, 2024
facts.quote: By January 1, 2024, all Oregon licensed PAs transitioned to collaborative practice and collaboration agreements.

facts.value: statute: pain management documentation every 36 months (rule is stricter: 24 months)
facts.quote: A physician associate shall submit to the board every 36 months documentation of completion of: (a) A one-hour pain management education program

facts.value: Suicide risk assessment and Alzheimer's disease CME count toward hours but are not required
facts.quote: Licensees practicing in primary care or geriatric care are encouraged to obtain the CME described here.

facts.value: Dispensing registration with OMB optional; PAs may not dispense Schedule I or II (with ORS 677.515(5) exception)
facts.quote: a physician associate may not dispense controlled substances classified in Schedule I or II

rn.renewalDeadline: Licences issued from Jan 1, 2026 expire two years from issue date; existing licences keep their current (birthdate based) expiry; renewal due by 11:59 p.m. on the expiry date; up to 90 days late before reinstatement
rn.ceHoursPerCycle: 0 general CE hours until Jan 1, 2028 (practice hour requirement removed Jan 1, 2026); from Jan 1, 2028: 20 hours per 2 years (pain and cultural competency hours count toward the 20)

topicMandates.topic: Pain management (Oregon Pain Management Commission course)
topicMandates.appliesTo: all LPN, RN and APRN applicants: at initial licensure and every 36 months
all licensees; rule text (amended eff. Sept 1, 2026) says every other renewal cycle; board fact sheet says in the past 48 months

aprn.title: APRN (Nurse Practitioner); Oregon titles e.g. APRN-FNP-C
aprn.separateLicenceOrCertificate: separate APRN (Nurse Practitioner) licence; requires an RN licence
aprn.ceHoursPerCycle: 0 hours if national certification is current (from Jan 1, 2028 all NPs must show primary source evidence of national certification); pain management and cultural competency still apply
aprn.nationalCertificationRequired: Yes for NPs initially licensed after Jan 1, 2011 now; all NPs from Jan 1, 2028

prescribing.separateAuthorityRegistration: Yes: prescriptive authority (and optional dispensing authority) applied for from OSBN; expires with the APRN licence; renewal requires an attestation that the Board's prescriptive and dispensing authority education video was reviewed
prescribing.pharmacologyCeForPrescribers: 45 contact hours pharmacology at initial application only; no per cycle pharmacology hours found
prescribing.controlledSubstanceCe: None beyond the pain management course

practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: No collaboration or supervision agreement found in ORS chapter 678 or OAR 851-031 / 851-055

facts.quote: A nursing license is valid for two years from the date it is issued.

facts.value: existing expiry dates unchanged; new licences two years from issue
facts.quote: New licenses and certificates issued after Jan. 1, 2026, will expire two years from the date the license was issued

facts.value: 20 hours per 2 years starting Jan 1, 2028
facts.quote: Starting January 1, 2028, all renewal applicants must complete the required CE hours ... LPN or RN applicants, 20 hours within the prior two years

facts.value: practice hours no longer required from Jan 1, 2026
facts.quote: As of January 1, 2026, practice hours will no longer be required to assure competency for Oregon licensed nurses.

facts.value: 1 hour at initial licensure and every 36 months
facts.quote: one-hour pain management education program ... at initial or endorsement licensure and every 36 months thereafter.

facts.value: 2 hours every other renewal cycle
facts.quote: All applicants must complete two hours of cultural competency continuing education (CE) every other renewal cycle.

facts.cite: OSBN interpretive statement on APRN title
facts.quote: Oregon is currently not a member of the nurse licensure compact (NLC).
facts.note: OSBN statement adopted 9-21-2023; current ORS chapter 678 (2025 edition, loaded) contains no Nurse Licensure Compact provision, and the NCSBN map (secondary) does not list Oregon.

facts.value: NPs initially licensed after Jan 1, 2011
facts.quote: NP applicants initially licensed after January 1, 2011 ... verification of current national certification congruent with license type and population focus

facts.value: all NPs from Jan 1, 2028
facts.quote: All Oregon Nurse Practioner (NP) and Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist (CRNA) applicants must provide primary source evidence of national certification.
facts.note: OSBN competency page says APRN applicants from 2028 need national certification OR 75 hours; the rule (amended eff. 9-1-2026) gives the 75 hour route only to CNSs; the rule is used for NPs.

facts.value: national certification fulfils CE (from 2028)
facts.quote: CRNA or NP applicants: Holding current national certification fulfills the continuing education requirement.

facts.value: 45 contact hours pharmacology at application
facts.quote: Documentation of at least 45 contact hours of pharmacology education

facts.value: prescriptive and dispensing authority expire with APRN licence
facts.quote: Prescriptive and dispensing authority expires with the APRN license.

facts.value: attest to reviewing Board education video
facts.quote: attestation that the applicant reviewed the Board's prescriptive and dispensing authority education video.

facts.value: OSBN may authorize Schedules II to V
facts.quote: may authorize a nurse practitioner or clinical nurse specialist to write prescriptions, including prescriptions for controlled substances listed in schedules II through V.

facts.value: APRN licensure rules moved from Division 53 to Division 31 on Jan 1, 2026
facts.quote: APRN licensure requirements, prescriptive privilege and dispensing authority amended into Division 31.

facts.value: pain management and cultural competency hours count toward the 20 hours (from 2028)
facts.quote: The CE listed in sections (1) and (2) of this rule may be counted toward the applicant’s required number of CE hours

unverified: PA and NP: no Oregon state controlled substance registration for practitioners was confirmed or ruled out in a primary source (OAR 847-050-0041(4) refers only to the federal DEA number); stateCsRegistrationRequired left null.
PA: ORS 677.510(5) says pain management documentation every 36 months, OAR 847-008-0075 and the OMB CE page say every 24 months; the rule (24 months) is used.
NP: 'full' practice authority is derived from the absence of any supervision or collaboration requirement in ORS 678 and OAR 851-031; no OSBN sentence using the phrase was loaded.
NP: Oregon NLC non membership rests on an OSBN statement adopted Sept 2023 plus absence of any compact provision in current ORS chapter 678; no 2026 dated OSBN statement was loaded.

NP: OSBN competency page (2028: national certification or 75 hours for APRNs) conflicts with OAR 851-031-0008(3)(c)-(d) (NP must show national certification; 75 hours is the CNS route); the rule is used.
NP and PA: DEA MATE one-time 8 hours is federal, not researched as a state rule.
verificationCorrections: OR PA cultural competency: researcher recorded 1 hour "every cycle"; OAR 847-008-0077(1)(a) requires a minimum of 1 hour PER YEAR (2 per 2 year registration period, 4 per 4 year audit period), reported every other renewal. Topic mandate corrected.

OR PA: 9 OMB rule facts re-sourced from the Cornell LII copy to the Secretary of State OARD official rule pages (loaded in a browser); current versions confirmed (847-008-0070 amended eff. 1-12-2026, 847-008-0005 and 847-050-0082/0041 amended eff. 10-10-2024). Values and quotes unchanged.

OR NP: OAR 851-031-0008, -0043, -0048 re-loaded as full official text (researcher had only a summarising fetch); every quote matches the rule as amended eff. 9-1-2026.
